decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis (Cav.) Trin. ex Steud.
decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts the species combination, published 1841. Retain existing species-level canonical concept.

decisions.source_name: Arundo australis Cav.
decisions.reason: POWO lists Cav.'s 1799 name as the homotypic basionym; historical Arundo label does not require a new species.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis subsp. americanus Saltonst., P.M.Peterson & Soreng
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. americanus Saltonst., P.M.Peterson & Soreng
decisions.reason: POWO accepts the North American subspecies, published in Sida 21:690 (2004). This rank does not automatically certify any specimen.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis subsp. australis
decisions.reason: POWO accepts the autonymic subspecies; distinguish rank from broad species-level labels.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis subsp. berlandieri (E.Fourn.) Saltonst. & Hauber
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. berlandieri (E.Fourn.) Saltonst. & Hauber
decisions.reason: POWO accepts the 2007 subspecies combination; its biological origin in the US is disputed independently of the accepted nomenclatural rank.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis subsp. isiacus (Arcang.) J.H.Xue, Chepinoga & K.P.Ma
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. isiacus (Arcang.) J.H.Xue, Chepinoga & K.P.Ma
decisions.reason: POWO accepts a fourth subspecies with combination published in 2024; do not silently assume the species contains only the three North American lineages.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites americanus (Saltonst., P.M.Peterson & Soreng) A.Haines
decisions.reason: POWO treats Haines's 2010 species-rank combination as homotypic synonym of accepted subsp. americanus; preserve source label and rank history.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis var. americanus (Saltonst., P.M.Peterson & Soreng) Tiehm
decisions.reason: POWO places Tiehm's 2023 variety-rank combination under the accepted subspecies; do not create a separate variety concept.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis var. berlandieri (E.Fourn.) C.F.Reed
decisions.reason: POWO treats the 1987 variety combination as synonym of accepted subsp. berlandieri.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis subsp. altissimus (Benth.) Clayton
decisions.reason: POWO resolves the historical 1968 subspecies to the newly accepted 2024 isiacus combination, not to a separately accepted altissimus subspecies.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites flavescens (Custer) Hegetschw.
decisions.reason: POWO treats the historical species-level name as a synonym of accepted subsp. australis.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites altissimus (Benth.) Mabille
decisions.reason: POWO resolves the historical species-rank name to accepted subsp. isiacus, not a separate modern species.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites mauritianus Kunth
decisions.reason: POWO accepts P. mauritianus as distinct species, not an interchangeable P. australis subspecies; potential hybrid ancestry in the Gulf literature does not collapse accepted taxa.

decisions.source_name: All records labelled Phragmites australis = introduced Eurasian lineage
decisions.reason: Accepted species contains four subspecies; unqualified species label does not resolve lineage or invasiveness, and no card-level photograph has been genotyped.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites americanus treated as separately accepted species under POWO
decisions.reason: POWO currently places the 2010 species-rank name as homotypic synonym of accepted P. australis subsp. americanus. Alternative species concepts may be recorded without duplicate automatic installation.

decisions.source_name: Existing species-level Phragmites australis photographs and Michigan comparison photograph
decisions.reason: Source-labelled species/subspecies images are not independent lineage/genotype confirmation for Texas plants; do not relabel existing gallery, certify subspecies, or modify photographs.

decisions.source_name: Any Texas Phragmites australis specimen with no voucher/diagnostic lineage evidence
decisions.reason: Keep lineage undetermined unless supported by same-specimen diagnostic data and, when necessary, molecular markers; species-level occurrence cannot be automatically promoted to americanus/australis/berlandieri.

decisions.source_name: Suspected Phragmites hybrid/introgressed individuals
decisions.reason: 2025 primary study explains that chloroplast markers alone do not identify F1 hybridization and nuclear markers can screen for it. No current card specimen was independently tested; preserve hybrid hold.

decisions.source_name: US origin status of P. australis subsp. berlandieri
decisions.accepted_target: ACCEPTED SUBSPECIES; US ORIGIN INTERPRETATION DISPUTED
decisions.reason: POWO lists the subspecies native in Texas, while 2023 genetic protocol describes US Gulf Coast populations as cryptogenic and reports proposed inter-lineage hybrid origins. Preserve disagreement without any county nativity audit or range-field write.

decisions.source_name: Historical authorless Phragmites australis/communis/americanus/berlandieri records lacking rank or voucher
decisions.reason: Do not auto-map authorless or broad historical records to a modern subspecies or infer native/introduced lineage; recover complete name, authorship, original rank and voucher when possible.

scientific_holds_preserved: Source-level photographs do not establish subspecies of any Texas individual
No molecular evidence of hybrid/introgressed ancestry on canonical card
Gulf Coast berlandieri US origin disputed among authorities
